title: Firewall Hardening
story: A vulnerable server exposes insecure services. Students must configure UFW firewall rules to secure the system while maintaining SSH access.

tasks.title: Run Nmap Scan
tasks.description: Scan the target to identify exposed services before applying firewall rules.
tasks.hint: Use nmap against the target machine.

tasks.title: Enable UFW
tasks.description: Enable the uncomplicated firewall on the target server.

tasks.title: Allow SSH
tasks.description: Add a firewall rule that allows SSH traffic so administrators keep access.
tasks.hint: Allow port 22 or the SSH service profile.

tasks.title: Block Telnet
tasks.description: Deny inbound Telnet traffic on port 23.

tasks.title: Verify Firewall Status
tasks.description: List active firewall rules and confirm SSH is allowed while Telnet is denied.
